_comment: Chapter 12's requirements catalog: for each step of the managed service account standard, the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls its output provides evidence for and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators whose related controls include them. Control mappings: Book 13, Appendix A and the service-account and Non-Person Identity guides; KSIs: the related-controls lists on https://www.fedramp.gov/2026/reference/key-security-indicators/, re-read on November 20, 2026 (WD-169). 'primaryKsi' is the indicator the program leads with for non-user accounts. KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with them and doesn't report them. The alignment is the program's reading (design guidance), to be reconciled with Book 13, Appendix A.
